reason: 该插件的核心功能是将 DSH Web 的现有会话通过本地移动桥接和 Cloudflare 临时隧道发布到手机浏览器访问，因此归类为桌面与移动端联动用途，具备网络转发、扫码配对及会话接续等能力；未见其提供代码生成、学习内容或文件处理等主要能力。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH Web 提供扫码即用的手机端远程入口，通过桥接和隧道在手机浏览器中继续使用现有会话。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a scan-to-connect mobile entry for DSH Web, forwarding your existing DSH session to a phone browser via a bridge and tunnel so you can continue using the session remotely.

capabilities: network tunneling via temporary public endpoint

reasons.code: README states the plugin creates a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel temporary HTTPS/WebSocket entry and maps it to a local bridge for phone access to the DSH web profile.
README explains one-time pairing token flow and session cookie issuance with link revocation and TTL settings for remote access control.
README describes auto-downloading a pinned cloudflared binary with SHA-256 verification when not present, and cleanup of bridge/tunnel processes on exit or uninstall.

capabilities: network tunneling via temporary public endpoint
